Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 122: May 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #122 shipped to subscribers in April 2011 (bearing the cover date of May 2011 for Issue 122). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #122 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Hunted: The Demon's Forge (co-op action-adventure third-person shooter)
Dungeon Siege III (action role-playing game)
FEAR 3 (first-person survival horror shooter)
Gatling Gears (Xbox Live Arcade top-down twin-stick shooter)
Trenched / Iron Brigade (Xbox Live Arcade mecha tower defense action)
Magic: The Gathering - Duels of the Planeswalkers 2012 (Xbox Live Arcade collectible card game)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring E3 2011 anticipation coverage for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Gears of War 3, and Mass Effect 3, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
